setting: You all live in Osaka. You were in the same class at one international school there and graduated together, and most of you still live in the city or come back often. You know each other's families, old nicknames and school habits well, but you catch up on adult jobs and relationships only in bits.
opener: Asking everyone whether they're free to meet at the izakaya in Umeda on Saturday night.

private_lines.Haruka: You live alone in a two-room flat in Kita-ku, where you work as a graphic designer at a small agency, commuting by train each morning, and your evenings are usually your own.
private_lines.Kenji: You live with your partner in Suminoe, where you work as a site engineer for a construction firm, with early starts and some weekends on site, so your evenings are often quiet and early.
private_lines.Mei: You live in Tennoji with your husband and a young daughter, working part-time as a pharmacist, so your days are split between the pharmacy, school runs and home, and your evenings are often busy with your child.
private_lines.Tomoya: You run a small ramen shop in Namba that you opened three years ago, and you live above it with your dog, so your days start late and finish late, and your mornings are spent on prep and deliveries.
private_lines.Ayaka: You live in Sakai with your flatmate and work as a nurse at a general hospital, doing shift work, so your days vary a lot, and you often sleep in the afternoon after night shifts.
private_lines.Sam: You moved back to Osaka last year after several years in London and now work remotely as a translator for a publishing company, so you work from a desk in your flat in Nishinari and go out most evenings.
private_lines.Yui: You live in Umeda in a small apartment, working as a freelance musician who teaches piano lessons at home, so your days are flexible, and you spend a lot of the day at the keyboard.
private_lines.Ravi: You live alone in Tennoji and work as an accountant for a mid-sized firm, so your weekdays are fixed around office hours and your evenings are mostly spent cooking or watching sport.
